name: spatialRepresentationType
displayName: Method used to represent geographic information in the dataset (ISO 19115 MD_SpatialRepresentationTypeCode): vector, raster or other, for example tables; one value per type present

name: topicCategory
displayName: High-level thematic classification of the dataset (ISO 19115 MD_TopicCategoryCode); one value per category

name: presentationForm
displayName: Form in which the dataset is presented (ISO 19115 CI_PresentationFormCode): digital map, digital image, model…

name: geogPurpose
displayName: Summary of the intentions with which the dataset was developed (ISO 19115 purpose). The purpose of the project or agreement that funded it goes in Project Purpose (institutional block)

name: maintenanceAndUpdateFrequency
displayName: Frequency with which changes and additions are made to the dataset after it is completed (ISO 19115 MD_MaintenanceFrequencyCode)

name: geogDateRange
displayName: Time period the geographic data refer to (ISO 19115 EX_TemporalExtent); for a single date, use the same start and end date

name: geogStartDate
displayName: Start date of the time period (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY)

name: geogEndDate
displayName: End date of the time period (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY)

name: geogSoftware
displayName: Software used to produce the geographic data (ISO 19115 environmentDescription); one entry per program

name: geogSoftwareName
displayName: Name of the software; one entry per program

name: referenceSystemIdentifier
displayName: Vector and raster data: coordinate reference system of the dataset, identified by its EPSG code (ISO 19115 referenceSystemInfo, RS_Identifier code, codeSpace EPSG); one value per reference system used

name: distributionFormat
displayName: Vector and raster data: format in which the geographic data are distributed in this dataset (ISO 19115 MD_Format name); one value per format. Web services (WMS, WFS…) are described as external references

name: geogOnlineService
displayName: Vector and raster data: only for the particular case where the data are published as a web service, not as files: type of the service (ISO 19115 CI_OnlineResource protocol). File formats go in Distribution format; the service URL goes in External references

name: equivalentScale
displayName: Vector data only: denominator of the representative fraction (scale) of the vector data (ISO 19115 spatialResolution equivalentScale); one value per scale

name: topologyLevel
displayName: Vector data only: degree of complexity of the spatial relationships of the vector data (ISO 19115 MD_TopologyLevelCode). If the data have no topology rules (most common case: shapefile, geopackage), choose geometryOnly. If the layers have different levels, give the most complete one

name: geometricObjects
displayName: Vector data only: type and number of the geometric objects of the vector data (ISO 19115 MD_GeometricObjects); one entry per geometry type

name: geometricObjectType
displayName: Vector data only: type of the geometric objects (ISO 19115 MD_GeometricObjectTypeCode). If the data have several geometry types, one entry per type

name: geometricObjectCount
displayName: Vector data only: number of geometric objects (features) of this type in the whole dataset (sum over all layers of this type) (ISO 19115 geometricObjectCount)

name: resolutionDistance
displayName: Raster data only: ground sample distance (cell size) of the raster data: value and unit (ISO 19115 spatialResolution distance); one entry per resolution

name: resolutionDistanceValue
displayName: Raster data only: size of a cell along one axis, in the unit given in Unit (ISO 19115 gco:Distance)

name: resolutionDistanceUnit
displayName: Raster data only: unit of the spatial resolution (uom attribute of the ISO 19115 distance)

name: coverageDescription
displayName: Raster data only: what the cell values represent, as a content type and a description (ISO 19115 MD_CoverageDescription); one entry per kind of content

name: coverageContentType
displayName: Raster data only: type of information represented by the cell values of the grid data (ISO 19115 MD_CoverageContentTypeCode)

name: attributeDescription
displayName: Raster data only: description of what the cell values of the grid data represent: variable and unit, bands (ISO 19115 attributeDescription and band descriptors)

name: satelliteScene
displayName: Raster data only, satellite images: reference grid and path/row of each scene (no ISO 19115 equivalent); one entry per scene

name: pathrowReference
displayName: Raster data only: reference grid in which the path and row are given

name: pathrow
displayName: Raster data only: path and row of the scene

name: gridSpatialRepresentation
displayName: Raster data only: technical properties of the grid (ISO 19115 MD_GridSpatialRepresentation); if the rasters have different structures, describe the main one

name: numberOfDimensions
displayName: Raster data only: number of independent spatio-temporal axes (ISO 19115 numberOfDimensions); 2 for a common raster (x, y), 3 if it includes time or height

name: cellGeometry
displayName: Raster data only: whether the grid data represent points or areas (ISO 19115 MD_CellGeometryCode); area in almost all cases (each cell covers an area), point if each value corresponds to a point, for example the cell centre

name: transformationParameterAvailability
displayName: Raster data only: whether parameters for transformation between image coordinates and geographic or map coordinates exist (ISO 19115 transformationParameterAvailability)

name: geographicQualityControl
displayName: Description of the quality checks applied to the geographic data: topological validation, positional and thematic accuracy, completeness (ISO 19115 data quality)

name: lineage
displayName: General explanation of the sources and production processes of the dataset, including the references of the sources used (ISO 19115 lineage statement, process steps and sources)
blockURI: Land cover digitized on 2018 Landsat 8 images at 1:100,000; generalization and topological validation in ArcGIS

name: geographicBiases
displayName: Description of potential biases for the dataset (I2D field, no ISO 19115 equivalent)

name: illustration
displayName: Image that previews the dataset, usually a small map (ISO 19115 graphicOverview); one entry per image. Kept until dataset thumbnails are handled for all catalogues

name: illustrationFile
displayName: Address (URL) of the image. For records migrated from GeoNetwork, the original link: it stops working when GeoNetwork is retired, so the image itself must be kept

name: illustrationDescription
displayName: Short caption of the image (ISO 19115 fileDescription)

name: illustrationFormat
displayName: Format of the image file (ISO 19115 fileType)
